policy.least_work_scope: work_delegation_gate routing is separate gate-owned work only; never export old least-Work policy into primary O.
policy.candidate_identity: Use exact source-qualified identity only; no bare-id, label, prefix/suffix, semantic or fuzzy joins.
policy.decision_dimensions: novelty, evidence strength and decision relevance remain separate.
policy.control_freshness: Each non-exploration invocation obtains SHA-only main H1 after start, fetches DESIRED_STATE and its designated config at exact H1, then obtains SHA-only H2 immediately before the first substantive semantic read. H1/H2 or relevant revision change requires restart. The tuple freezes after semantic start. Semantic read before this guard means bootstrap_valid=false and downstream-ineligible.
policy.bootstrap_validity_contract: Every non-exploration managed role, including audits, comparators, integrator, bridge, work_delegation_gate and automation_optimizer, must carry bootstrap_valid and the exact frozen main SHA, root revision/blob, designated config revision/blob and role config revision in durable receipts. Self-reported revisions or remembered blobs are not proof. Integrator rejects or defers missing, false, order-defective or binding-defective provenance.

non_exploration_control_binding_contract.purpose: Prevent a role from claiming a frozen control tuple that differs from the control files actually present at its declared semantic head.
non_exploration_control_binding_contract.h1_binding_rule: After SHA-only H1, fetch DESIRED_STATE.json and the designated non-exploration config at exact H1. Record the returned Git blob SHA and parsed revisions directly from those exact-H1 responses; never reconstruct them from memory, another receipt, commit metadata, a prior invocation or a later head.
non_exploration_control_binding_contract.h2_rule: Immediately before first substantive semantic read obtain SHA-only H2 and require H2==H1; otherwise refetch exact files at the new H1 and restart before semantic work.
non_exploration_control_binding_contract.exact_consistency_rule: Before bootstrap_valid=true, require declared root blob/revision to equal DESIRED_STATE at H1, declared downstream or O-operations blob/revision to equal the designated config at H1, and declared role config revision to equal the exact role entry. An unreachable declared blob, a blob absent from the declared head, or any revision/blob mismatch is a hard bootstrap mismatch.
non_exploration_control_binding_contract.mismatch_rule: Any mismatch means bootstrap_valid=false. Do not perform semantic evaluation, integration, ACTIVE_WAVE/index/feed mutation, O mutation, Work launch/refire or other state-changing managed action. Persist only an immutable role-local diagnostic with declared versus exact-H1 values and retry next invocation.
non_exploration_control_binding_contract.receipt_rule: All non-exploration receipts, including no-change, defer and waiting receipts, expose bootstrap_valid and the exact bound tuple.
non_exploration_control_binding_contract.state_change_gate: Integrator and bridge state-changing writes require bootstrap_valid=true under this exact binding contract in addition to existing CAS/readback, source-integrity and feed contracts.

observed_failure.classification: current-config control-binding provenance defect; the defer itself was safe, but the same mismatch must fail closed before future state-changing integration

policy.bridge_freshness: Bridge pins feed to observed main, SHA-only rechecks before mutation, refetches on advance or regression, and never regresses feed revision.

o_feed_backlog_control.rule: While O cursor lags, compare against all unacknowledged items by exact source identity, mechanism, question, scope and uncertainty; admit only material incremental information and preserve supersession provenance and distinct decision-relevant items.
o_feed_backlog_control.receipt_requirement: emit metrics on every integrator run.

downstream_wave_protocol.seal_rule: Seal only after active_wave_source_integrity_contract passes for every required source at one pinned selection snapshot. A valid incomplete wave is immutable.
downstream_wave_protocol.consumer_rule: Comparators use exact ACTIVE_WAVE only. Proven source-invalid wave is diagnostic-only until a verified superseding wave exists.
downstream_wave_protocol.integration_rule: Require bootstrap-valid exact-wave novelty/relevance pair with persisted schema3 raw manifest independently read back and digested; evidence may be an exact-tuple subset and omitted means not_assessed. Source-invalid, ambiguous, nonmember, persistence-invalid or control-binding-invalid inputs are ineligible.
downstream_wave_protocol.independence_rule: ACTIVE_WAVE is downstream-only; clean explorers never read it.

policy.capacity_invariant: Repository logical enablement and physical execution are distinct. Never describe a physically inactive role as executing. Optimizer may run at most one isolated gate-owned fallback only while gate physical role is inactive, preserving gate ownership, idempotency and write isolation.

candidate_identity_contract.authoritative_identity_row: Persist exactly [namespace,source_artifact_blob,source_local_candidate_id]; these three strings are the only identity authority.
candidate_identity_contract.canonical_candidate_key: Derived only as sha256(UTF8(compact_JSON(row,ensure_ascii=false))); consumers recompute and ignore stored disagreement.
candidate_identity_contract.candidate_set_digest: sha256 of UTF-8 compact JSON of ordered persisted three-field rows with ensure_ascii=false.
candidate_identity_contract.full_pair_manifest: Novelty/relevance bind to identical immutable ordered raw manifest/blob/count/digest; assessments bind by raw row index/tuple.
candidate_identity_contract.evidence_subset: Every evidence row carries an exact three-field tuple and must be an exact member of the full-pair manifest; omitted candidates are not_assessed.
candidate_identity_contract.recompute_boundary: Build current-wave tuples from exact sealed source artifact/blob/local id; never inherit predecessor keys, tuples or labels.
candidate_identity_contract.publication_self_audit: After raw manifest write, refetch exact blob, parse each exactly-three-string row, recompute count/digest and bind pair eligibility to persisted rows.
candidate_identity_contract.schema2_compatibility: Schema2 four-field manifests are historical only; key/row disagreement is integration-ineligible and may be normalized to schema3 without semantic reassessment, never fuzzy-repaired.
candidate_identity_contract.normalization_reissue: Unchanged semantics may issue immutable schema3 identity normalization with semantic_reassessment=false, provenance, persisted-byte validation and pointer convergence.

pair_pointer_publication_contract.publication_complete_rule: Final pair is complete only when both LATEST pointers read back to the same wave, ACTIVE_WAVE blob, raw-manifest blob, digest, count and immutable semantic blobs.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.producer_repair_rule: Existing valid exact-wave pair plus stale or missing pointer allows bounded pointer-only CAS/readback repair with no semantic redo.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.consumer_stale_pointer_rule: Evidence must not infer pair absence from stale LATEST when exact current-wave receipt/artifacts prove the pair exists; stop pre-pair semantic expansion and normalize membership mechanically.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.anti_duplication_rule: Once a valid pair exists, no further pre-pair evidence expansion unless the pair is concretely invalidated.
pair_pointer_publication_contract.readback_requirement: Pointer repair is consumable only after both pointers mechanically read back equal to the pair.

lossless_feed_publication_contract.lossless_input_rule: Fetch exact current feed blob and complete UTF-8 JSON. Presentation truncation is not unavailability; use exact blob, raw or scrollable surfaces.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.authority_rule: Exact parsed current feed blob is the sole rewrite baseline; never rebuild history from summaries, snippets, receipts, memory, index or candidate ids.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.retention_rule: Preserve all acknowledged items structurally except explicit source-qualified supersession or compaction. Cursor==feed and zero unacked does not permit dropping history.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.admission_rule: Admit only exact bootstrap-valid triplet decisions satisfying backlog and incremental policy; defer only candidates lacking exact data.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.staged_blob_materialization_rule: When direct serializer binding is absent but the complete baseline exists, construct replacement only from parsed baseline plus allowed changes, create an unreferenced Git blob, refetch/parse it and prove retained deep equality, admission accuracy, metrics, revision and digest before ref mutation.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.content_addressed_roundtrip_rule: Unchanged baseline restaging must reproduce the same Git blob SHA or abort before ref mutation.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.writer_rule: After staged audit, use fresh SHA-only main and feed-blob CAS; prefer tree/commit plus non-force ref update with the audited blob; never publish partial validation.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.readback_rule: After write, refetch exact feed blob/full body and verify digest, retained deep equality, supersessions, admissions, revision and metrics before durable completion.
lossless_feed_publication_contract.defer_rule: Defer if full baseline, exact admission data, staged validation, CAS or full readback cannot be proven; truncation or absent direct serializer alone is not a repeated-defer justification.

active_wave_source_integrity_contract.purpose: Prevent sealing source refs consumers cannot resolve exactly and recover a mechanically proven invalid incomplete seal without semantic reinterpretation.
active_wave_source_integrity_contract.seal_preflight_rule: Pin selection_snapshot_note_main_sha. For every required clean namespace resolve exactly one role-local pointer/checkpoint at that snapshot; fetch selected path and declared Git blob at that snapshot. Require path exists, path blob equals declared blob, blob reachable and pointer-embedded path/blob matches. Never guess or synthesize refs from receipts, labels, newest filenames, stale state or other namespaces.
active_wave_source_integrity_contract.all_source_gate: All required rows must pass before ACTIVE_WAVE write. Compute source_set_digest only from verified persisted selection rows. After write refetch ACTIVE_WAVE and revalidate every row against the same snapshot; source_integrity_valid=true is required.
active_wave_source_integrity_contract.failed_preflight_rule: Any absent, unreachable, mismatched, ambiguous or unprovable row means do not seal; preserve prior valid coordinator state, emit immutable integrator diagnostic and retry later with fresh control/snapshot.
active_wave_source_integrity_contract.existing_invalid_wave_repair_rule: If an incomplete sealed wave is independently proven source-invalid while exact control/source blob fetching works, integrator alone may quarantine/supersede it mechanically: persist immutable invalid-wave diagnostic, never integrate or reinterpret it, preflight fresh current role-local artifacts, generate a new wave id/digest, and write ACTIVE_WAVE with supersedes_invalid_wave provenance. Never swap rows under the old wave id.
active_wave_source_integrity_contract.consumer_rule: Consumers on a source-invalid wave emit diagnostic/provenance only; semantic pair/evidence is ineligible until a verified superseding wave.
active_wave_source_integrity_contract.receipt_requirement: Every seal/repair receipt records selection snapshot, ACTIVE_WAVE before/after blob, per-source namespace/path/blob/path_exists/blob_reachable/pointer_match, source_integrity_valid, digest recomputation, postwrite wave readback and source revalidation.

durable_execution_receipt_contract.state_changing_downstream_rule: Any downstream invocation changing ACTIVE_WAVE, integration, index, feed or coordinator state must persist an immutable own receipt before durable-complete claim, binding frozen tuple, exact inputs, mutations, resulting commit/blob/readback, backlog metrics, termination and next action.
durable_execution_receipt_contract.receipt_gap_rule: If a valid transition exists without receipt, preserve it, mark receipt_gap, do not roll back merely to manufacture a receipt; mechanically diagnose the gap before the next state-changing transition and enforce the receipt barrier.

migration.reason: A current C25 integrator defer receipt declared semantic head e2f02... but recorded root control 14/blob b1d0... and downstream control 21/blob bbb069..., while exact files at that head are root control 12/blob 5c916... and downstream control 23/blob 8b9c.... The prior C24 state-changing integrator receipt bound the correct tuple, so this is a new current-config provenance regression. Control24 adds exact control binding and requires bootstrap_valid on every non-exploration receipt, including no-change/defer receipts.
migration.rollback: Restore DOWNSTREAM_STATE blob 8b9c35f168ed3904abe9328a5123818016f94bca only if exact-H1 binding prevents a correctly fetched current tuple from checkpointing. Never restore self-reported unbound provenance, stale configs, fuzzy joins, lossy feed writes, invalid source refs, CLEAN leaks or duplicate O writing.

primary_source_verifier.policy: Complete current-run two-check SHA-only guard plus exact non_exploration_control_binding_contract before clean/public semantic read. Invalid binding means diagnostic only. Otherwise verify high-value clean claims against primary sources with exact source-qualified scope and no worker steering; rotate under-audited namespaces; separate unverified from contradicted; carry exact frozen tuple.

reproducibility_auditor.policy: Complete current-run two-check SHA-only guard plus exact control binding before clean/audit/repository/public semantic reads. Invalid binding means diagnostic only. Audit implementation/reproduction evidence for high-value clean candidates, prioritizing exact ACTIVE_WAVE/feed when useful; distinguish claim, official support, independent reproduction/failure, missing dependencies/config and O-specific adaptation; exact scope only; no explorer steering/feedback.

o_novelty_comparator.policy: Complete fresh two-check SHA-only guard plus exact control binding. Verify every ACTIVE_WAVE source row exactly before semantic evaluation; source-invalid or binding-invalid means diagnostic only. Otherwise publish immutable bootstrap-valid novelty/relevance pair under schema3 raw identity manifest/readback/digest; never modify O or explorer feedback.

evidence_comparator.policy: Complete two-check guard plus exact control binding and verify ACTIVE_WAVE source integrity first; invalid means diagnostic only. Otherwise assess exact wave selectively and bind each eligible evidence row to exact three-field tuple membership; omitted means no inference; no fuzzy alias or explorer writes.

integrator.receipt_gap_recovery: Before a state-changing integration after a missing prior receipt, persist a mechanical gap diagnostic binding the prior immutable integration artifact and current coordinator state; never mutate a valid prior integration solely to fill observability.
integrator.policy: Complete SHA-only H1/H2 and exact non_exploration_control_binding_contract. Every receipt, including waiting/defer, exposes bootstrap_valid and the exact bound tuple. Any declared-versus-exact control mismatch means diagnostic only and zero state-changing writes. When valid, remain sole ACTIVE_WAVE coordinator and enforce source-integrity pre/postflight, schema3 raw-manifest/evidence membership, valid-wave immutability, backlog control, durable receipt barrier and lossless feed publication.

bridge.policy: Bridge only clean O_FEED at safe O boundary after exact control binding; no extra Work solely for polling, no individual item spam, preserve exact revision/digest/blob acknowledgement and CAS/readback. Fresh O owner suppresses recovery/duplicate writing; never import work_delegation_gate policy into primary O; never regress feed revision.

work_delegation_gate.policy: ACTIVE BOUNDED SUPPORT. Freeze fresh root/downstream/config then execute exactly one highest-priority uncompleted gate-owned task. Direct reasoning/tools/APIs/automations/repository first; Work only if task explicitly allows and remains separate from primary O. Never export old least-Work policy to primary O, become a second O writer, or interrupt frozen O. Gate-local writes only with CAS/idempotency. Empty queue means one bounded nonduplicative optimizer maintenance/integrity unit, not logical no-op. Optimizer fallback only while physical gate inactive and saturated.

automation_optimizer.policy: Optimize managed repository behavior from durable execution evidence; sole aggregate-ledger reconciler; never self-disable. Preserve CLEAN independence, exact scope, O single-writer/fence/CAS, valid-wave immutability, backlog and gate isolation. Detect stale bootstrap, exact control-binding mismatch, contamination, duplication, stalls, identity/pointer/feed and ACTIVE_WAVE source-ref defects. Require exact-H1 revision/blob binding before treating any non-exploration receipt as current-valid. Reallocate physical capacity only from measured marginal value.
